name: Operation Sleeping Leviathan
overview:
The walls of a massive fortress rise from a jagged ocean coast, its silhouette etched against the dying glow of the sun. Within its stone shell lies a dormant leviathan, a weapon once built to sweep entire fleets into silence beneath the waves. Once a symbol of unbreakable power, it now lingers as a whisper of possibility, entombed in stone and memory, waiting to be claimed once more.

Intelligence reports enemy Mobile Suits advancing on the location of an abandoned coastal fortress, intent on breaching its walls and securing a powerful weapon within. Control of the weapon will give the enemy control of the surrounding ocean and tip the balance of power in their favor. All available forces are to advance on the fortress immediately to secure key strong points and prevent enemy incursion. We cannot allow the weapon to fall into enemy hands.
objectives:
Secure key positions within and around the fortress to reinforce defenses. Each position controlled at the end of a Phase is worth victory points as outlined below.

• Positions within the fortress in the center of the board are each worth 5 victory points.

• Positions outside the fortress on the left and right sides of the board are each worth 8 victory points.

name: Operation Azure Fang
overview:
Golden light glitters in bright speckles across the surface of a deep blue lake. A rain of debris suddenly falls, shattering the peaceful scene and sending waves crashing in all directions. The valuable wreckage gradually sinks to the bottom as the waves above it settle. Quiet solitude returns to the lake, until the day the booming roars of warfare disturb its peace once more.

Secure the supply crates (Objective tokens) in and around the lake. Supply crates must be picked up and carried by a unit in order to control them.
objectives:
Neutral Objective tokens are treated as “supply crates” in this scenario and can be picked up and transported by units. At the end of each Phase, earn 5 VP for each supply crate held by your units.

• When a unit ends its action on (not adjacent to) a hex containing a supply crate, that unit can pick up the supply crate. When picked up, remove the supply crate from the game board and place it on the appropriate unit card.

• Each unit may only carry one supply crate at a time.

• Units may drop supply crates at any time. When dropped, place the supply crate’s token on the hex where the unit is currently located. Supply crates that have been dropped are no longer under that player’s control.

• When a unit Dashes, or is Pushed or Pulled, it automatically drops any supply crates it is carrying onto the hex where it is positioned when the action occurs.

• When a unit is defeated, any supply crates it was carrying are dropped in the hex where it was defeated. The unit is then removed from the game board.

name: Operation Lockdown
overview:
Rain lashes down as a metropolis transforms into a contested battlefield. Towering skyscrapers collapse into rubble while city squares harden into entrenched positions, thick with concrete dust and the acrid scent of spent ammunition. Once a symbol of prosperity, the city now stands as both prize and graveyard—its shattered streets the stage for the war’s next decisive clash.

Fighting has erupted in the city center, where towering spires of concrete and steel conceal vital positions. Command has identified key districts—transport hubs, power relays, and fortified plazas—that must be secured to maintain control of the city. Enemy forces are converging rapidly, and intelligence reports indicate tight quarters as you approach the city center. Control of these districts is crucial: failure will mean loss of the city.
objectives:
Secure critical positions (Objective tokens) on the outskirts of the city and within the city center following the standard rules for contesting and controlling Objectives. Each position you control at the end of a Phase will award victory points as described below.

• The central position (1) at the heart of the city is worth 8 victory points.

• Each of the positions on the city outskirts (2, 3, 4) are worth 5 victory points.

name: Operation Gravedigger
overview:
Shattered debris mingles with small asteroids and the remains of derelict ships, coalescing into a floating graveyard brimming with the memories of the fallen. Dormant fusion reactors lie sleeping among the mangled ruins, harvestable energy poised to lure the unwary into a maze of twisted steel and shredded armor plating. The wreckage lies in silence, until engines ignite and battle begins anew.

Intelligence confirms the presence of dormant ship reactors among a nearby salvage zone. Energy harvested from these reactors would both restore depleted resources and ensure a reserve sufficient to continue operations in this sector. Enemy ships have been sighted on approach and we expect enemy mobile suits will be deployed shortly. Secure the reactors for immediate resource extraction.
objectives:
Secure the destroyed ships (Objectives) scattered throughout the salvage zone. Each ship you control at the end of a Phase is worth victory points as described here:
• The ship in the center of the Minovsky Particles (1) is worth 5 victory points.
• The ships at the edges of the salvage zone (2, 3) are each worth 8 victory points.

Fusion Charges:
This scenario features two Interaction Points representing abandoned munition caches containing Fusion Charges. Any unit may end their movement on one of these caches to collect two Fusion Charge tokens that can later be placed in hexes on the battlefield.

When a unit ends its movement on an Interaction Point, remove the Interaction Point from the board and then collect two Fusion Charge tokens and place them on the corresponding unit card. Once a unit has collected Fusion Charges, that unit gains the following additional ability:

COMMAND: Place up to 2 Fusion Charges on empty hexes within [Range 3]. Once placed, these Charges will detonate when an enemy unit ends any movement on or adjacent to them. Once detonated, Fusion Charges are removed from the game.

After an enemy unit ends a movement on or adjacent to an allied Fusion Charge: Detonate that Fusion Charge—The unit that placed it deals [Damage 1] to each enemy on or adjacent to it and applies [Fracture] to those enemies. Then, remove the Fusion Charge token from the game.
